svg.title: BER comparison through an RF attenuator
svg.desc: The transmitter supplies the reference bits and the RF path; bitErrorRate compares its output with the received signal.
svg.metadata: {"title":"BER comparison through an RF attenuator","description":"The transmitter supplies the reference bits and the RF path; bitErrorRate compares its output with the received signal.","domain":"signal","source":{"file":"docs/.vitepress/theme/replExamples.js","result":"ber","combination":"nP.bitErrorRate(tx, chain, {receptions: 50})","exampleId":"ber-attenuation"},"viewBox":[0,0,760,500],"layout":{"centerAxisX":380,"centerReference":"transmit and receive comparison"},"components":[{"id":"tx","symbol":"digital/mod.svg","source":{"variable":"tx","constructor":"mod"},"at":[160,200],"sourceAnchor":[80,80],"connections":[{"port":1,"signal":"grid","at":[160,200]},{"port":2,"signal":"tx","at":[280,200]}]},{"id":"ber","symbol":"digital/bit-error-rate.svg","source":{"variable":"ber","constructor":"bitErrorRate"},"at":[460,260],"sourceAnchor":[80,80],"connections":[{"port":1,"signal":"tx","at":[460,260]},{"port":2,"signal":"received","at":[460,300]},{"port":3,"signal":"ber-result","at":[580,280]}]}],"wires":[{"signal":"grid","points":[[100,200],[160,200]]},{"signal":"tx","points":[[280,200],[340,200]]},{"signal":"tx","points":[[340,200],[340,260],[460,260]]},{"signal":"received","points":[[400,300],[460,300]]},{"signal":"ber-result","points":[[580,280],[640,280]]}],"terminals":[{"signal":"grid","at":[100,200]},{"signal":"tx","at":[340,200]},{"signal":"received","at":[400,300]},{"signal":"ber-result","at":[640,280]}],"labels":[{"componentId":"tx","text":"ASCII mod","at":[220,90],"anchor":"middle"},{"componentId":"ber","text":"bitErrorRate","at":[520,140],"anchor":"middle"},{"text":"to RF attenuator","at":[340,160],"anchor":"middle"},{"text":"received","at":[400,360],"anchor":"middle"},{"text":"BER","at":[640,340],"anchor":"middle"}]}
